rationale: The interactive 'Select All' master row (toggleSelectAll in VariableQueryValueSelector.vue) is a distinct behavior not covered anywhere. The closest analog dashboard-variables-default-values-chain.spec.js only covers the 'default value = all' toggle (defaultValueType: 'all', Workflow 3) — it never opens a multi-select dropdown and clicks the 'Select All'/'All' master row, and single-select 'All' is untested. No existing spec exercises the master-row checkbox, so a new Dashboards/ spec is required (matches run-context spec_path).
